svg.title: Agentrix WebAgent Platform control plane
svg.desc: Tenancy from operator to site; the people and surfaces; the change path that keeps coding agents governed; the global control layer; the operator tenant whose WebAgents run Zavora; and the cells, sandbox runner pools and Vultr account underneath.

g.font-family: Inter, 'DM Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
g.text: Agentrix WebAgent Platform · the control plane
Zavora runs on Zavora: operator work is done by WebAgents under human authority. Blue = Vultr product · coral = holds secrets · amber dashed = sealed, untrusted work.
TENANCY · DOWN ONLY BY SIGNED GRANT
PEOPLE & SURFACES · ONE SHELL, THREE SCOPES
a merge is not an approval
passkey, or MFA step-up · 1 or 2 people
CONTROL PLANE · GLOBAL LAYER (ams-1, standby fra-1)
OPERATOR TENANT · ZAVORA RUNS ON ZAVORA
Same governed path, plus an operator token (target × verb).
Never read site content · never approve an owner's card.
CELLS ON VULTR · ONE REGION'S STACK, ONE BLAST RADIUS
SANDBOX RUNNER POOLS · NO SECRETS · OUTSIDE KUBERNETES
Migration Factory: one fair-share queue for owners and agencies · per-job egress allowlists · polite crawler fleet-wide
